first_map.speaker: death
first_map.text: Eight tables. I deal at every one of them, so you will see at least one familiar face.

first_map.speaker: death
first_map.text: You take them in order. People have asked me to change the order. I never have.

first_map.speaker: death
first_map.text: It is further than it looks. Most people say afterwards that it went quickly.
first_map.foreshadow: Reads as a remark about the tour. It is what people say to him about their lives.

player_loses_table.speaker: death
player_loses_table.text: That was not the end of anything. I would know.

player_loses_table.speaker: death
player_loses_table.text: You may try again. I do not say that to many people.

player_loses_table.speaker: death
player_loses_table.text: You lost the table, not the tour. I would tell you if it were otherwise.

player_loses_table.speaker: death
player_loses_table.text: The cards were fair. I do not know how to deal them any other way.

player_loses_table.speaker: death
player_loses_table.text: Most people only get to lose once. You may do it as often as you need.

player_loses_table.speaker: death
player_loses_table.text: Come back when you are ready. I will be dealing either way.

rematch_table.speaker: death
rematch_table.text: Back again. They remember you. So do I.

rematch_table.speaker: death
rematch_table.text: The same chairs, the same deck. You, I hope, somewhat different.

rematch_table.speaker: death
rematch_table.text: They have been talking about you since you left. Not kindly, but at length.

rematch_table.speaker: death
rematch_table.text: I shuffled while you were away. I do a great deal of shuffling.

replay_cleared.speaker: death
replay_cleared.text: You have beaten this table already. They have not forgotten, and they would like to discuss it.

replay_cleared.speaker: death
replay_cleared.text: Visiting? They will play you anyway. They have nowhere else to be.

replay_cleared.speaker: death
replay_cleared.text: Once is an event. Twice would be a habit.

open_table.speaker: death
open_table.text: No title is on the line tonight. Whoever came through the door plays, champions included. It is how most games have always been.

open_table.speaker: death
open_table.text: A champion may sit down tonight, but nobody is defending anything. They are only players again, and some of them are enjoying it.

open_table.speaker: death
open_table.text: I deal to whoever sits down. Nobody gets better cards for being famous.

open_table.speaker: death
open_table.text: No stakes worth mentioning tonight. Only cards. Some people prefer it.

resume.speaker: death
resume.text: You left in the middle of a hand. Nobody moved. Nobody could.

resume.speaker: death
resume.text: Your seat is exactly where you left it. So is everyone else.

resume.speaker: death
resume.text: You were gone a while. I am not the right one to ask how long.

table_won.speaker: death
table_won.text: Well played. I do not say it often. Keep that one.

table_won.speaker: death
table_won.text: All the chips. Enjoy them. They do not travel.

table_won.speaker: death
table_won.text: The table is yours for tonight. It will want you back. They always do.
